{
  "test_name": "LedgerIssueClosedGenericValueTypeFromReferencedAssembly",
  "test_code": "using System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Emit;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing FluentAssertions;\n\npublic class LedgerIssueClosedGenericValueTypeFromReferencedAssembly\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task GeneratesResolverWithoutCrashingOnMetadataClosedGenericValueType()\n    {\n        var messagePackReferences = ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack);\n        var frameworkReferences = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\nnamespace Lib;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic partial record struct Item<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key);\n\"\"\";\n\n        var libCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Lib\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(libSource) },\n            messagePackReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using var libStream = new MemoryStream();\n        var libEmit = libCompilation.Emit(libStream);\n        libEmit.Success.Should().BeTrue(string.Join(\"; \", libEmit.Diagnostics.Select(d => d.ToString())));\n        libStream.Position = 0;\n        var libRef = MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(libStream.ToArray());\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\nusing Lib;\nnamespace App;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n{\n    [Key(1)] public Item<int> Member { get; init; }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        var appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource) },\n            frameworkReferences.Concat(messagePackReferences).Concat(new[] { libRef }),\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        var generator = new MessagePackGenerator();\n        var driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(generator.AsSourceGenerator());\n        var runResult = driver.RunGenerators(appCompilation);\n\n        runResult.Diagnostics.Should().NotContain(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        var generatedSources = runResult.GeneratedSources.ToArray();\n        generatedSources.Should().NotBeEmpty(\"the app should emit a GeneratedMessagePackResolver\");\n        var generatedText = string.Join(\"\\n\", generatedSources.Select(g => g.SourceText.ToString()));\n        generatedText.Should().Contain(\"Resolver\");\n\n        var analyzer = new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer();\n        var analyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation.WithAnalyzers(analyzer).GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        analyzerDiagnostics.Should().NotContain(d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        analyzerDiagnostics.Should().NotContain(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n    }\n}"
}
